name: org.plantdatabases/askpulse
title: askPulse
description: Pulse and legume genes, synteny, QTL, GWAS, expression, paper search, SNP panels, germplasm

tools.name: search_data
find_germplasm
tools.description:
Find pulse and legume genebank accessions by accession number or name (e.g. 'ICC 4958' for chickpea at
ICRISAT): chickpea, lentil, pea, faba bean, lupin, grass pea, Phaseolus, Vigna, pigeonpea, soybean, peanut and
Medicago accessions from GBIF, with the holding genebank (FAO WIEWS code, e.g. IND002 = ICRISAT, SYR002/LBN002 =
ICARDA) and accession number; mostly Svalbard safety duplicates. Passport data are minimal (no traits).
Also INRAE GnpIS pea and faba bean collections via FAIDARE, with taxon, holding institute, country of origin,
status, pedigree and panels.

tools.name: data_sources
tools.description:
What askPulse currently indexes: record counts per database and data type, and data versions; plus the live
endpoints it queries or offers (BrAPI nodes, the CropSNPdb genotype API, its own MCP server and JSON API).

tools.name: find_gene
tools.description:
Look up a gene by Ensembl gene ID or gene name/symbol in Ensembl Plants: species, location, assembly, biotype,
description and link. Names are searched in all of: pisum_sativum (Cameor v1a), pisum_sativum_gca024323335v2gb (pea ZW6), pisum_sativum_gca964186695v1gb (pea JI2822), vicia_faba, lupinus_angustifolius, phaseolus_vulgaris, cajanus_cajan_gca000340665v2gb (pigeonpea), vigna_unguiculata_gca004118075v2rs (cowpea), vigna_radiata, vigna_angularis, glycine_max, glycine_soja, arachis_hypogaea, medicago_truncatula, trifolium_pratense (red clover) (or only in species, if given).
e.g. 'GLYMA_01G000600', 'Psat1g000360'.

tools.name: genes_in_region
tools.description:
Genes overlapping a region of one Ensembl Plants genome (max 5 Mb). species is an Ensembl name, e.g.
'pisum_sativum', 'vicia_faba', 'glycine_max' or 'lupinus_angustifolius'; chromosome names as in that assembly. Chromosome names differ by assembly: pea 1LG6..7LG7, narrow-leafed lupin LG01..LG20, soybean 1..20; faba bean uses ENA sequence accessions (e.g. OX451735.1).

tools.name: orthologues
tools.description:
Orthologues of a gene from Ensembl Plants Compara (gene trees across plant genomes), e.g. the Brassica copies
of an Arabidopsis gene. gene: Ensembl ID or name; target_species: Ensembl name to restrict to (e.g.
'medicago_truncatula' or 'pisum_sativum'). Returns orthologue IDs, species, relationship (one2one, one2many, many2many).

tools.name: arabidopsis_function
tools.description:
Function of a gene through its Arabidopsis thaliana orthologue(s): Ensembl Plants Compara orthologues, then
UniProtKB curated function, protein and gene names, mutant (disruption) phenotype, subcellular location and GO
terms, plus TAIR curation: symbol, full name, curator summary, GO terms with experimental evidence (with PubMed
IDs), mutant phenotypes of germplasm lines and the number of papers on the gene. gene: an Ensembl gene ID or name of any crop genome here, or an AGI (AT5G10140) / Arabidopsis name (FLC);
in askBrassica also a B. napus pangenome gene (BnaA01g00010.1D2, BnaPanG...).
one2many / many2many orthologues are all listed; the crop gene's own function is inferred, not shown.

tools.name: coexpressed_genes
tools.description:
Genes co-expressed with a gene, for guessing function and shortlisting candidates (e.g. under a QTL), from
ATTED-II union co-expression (thousands of RNA-seq samples per species; z-score, higher = stronger). For a crop
gene the Arabidopsis orthologue's co-expressed genes are listed, each with its TAIR symbol and description and its
orthologues back in the crop species; soybean genes (GLYMA_...) use soybean's own co-expression where loaded.
gene: an Ensembl gene ID or name of a crop genome here, or an AGI / Arabidopsis name. agi: choose which Arabidopsis
orthologue to use when there are several (default: the first). top: number of partners (max 50).
Co-expression across Arabidopsis samples is evidence about the Arabidopsis gene; the crop copies may differ.

tools.name: legume_gene
tools.description:
Chickpea or lentil gene from the Legume Information System (these genomes are not in Ensembl Plants), or a gene
of the extra faba bean and lentil gene sets: location, functional description, LIS legume gene family, curated
lentil symbols and gene lists (flowering, pigment, resistance gene analogues), best protein match to the reference
gene set, and link. gene: a gene ID (e.g. 'Ca1g000100', 'Lcu.2RBY.1g000010', 'Vfaba.Hedin2.R2.1g000001'), a
curated lentil symbol (e.g. 'LcFIE'), an Ensembl faba bean v1 ID (lists its v2/Tiffany counterparts) or words from
the description (e.g. 'flowering locus T'). Datasets: 'chickpea' = Cicer arietinum CDC Frontier (kabuli) assembly v3 (gene IDs like Ca1g000100, chromosomes chr1-chr8); 'chickpea_kabuli_v1' = the original kabuli CDC Frontier genes (Ca_00001 IDs used in most chickpea papers) placed on the UWA kabuli v2.6.3 assembly (Ca1-Ca8); 'chickpea_desi' = desi ICC 4958 genes (also Ca_ IDs, but different genes from the kabuli Ca_ IDs) on the UWA desi v3.0 assembly (Ca1-Ca8); 'lentil' = Lens culinaris CDC Redberry assembly v2 (IDs like Lcu.2RBY.1g000010, chromosomes Chr1-Chr7); extra gene sets (no LIS families; best protein match given): 'faba_v2' = faba bean Hedin/2 v2 (Vfaba.Hedin2.R2.1g000001, chr1_partA/B, chr2-chr6; matched to Ensembl Hedin/2 v1), 'faba_tiffany' = faba bean Tiffany (Vfaba.Tiffany.R1..., matched to Ensembl v1), 'lentil_greenstar' = lentil CDC Greenstar (Lcu.1GRN.1g000010) and 'lentil_ervoides' = Lens ervoides IG 72815 (Ler.1DRT.1g000010), both matched to LIS CDC Redberry v2. Gene families (LIS legume.fam3) also cover pea (Cameor, Psat... = Ensembl Plants pisum_sativum IDs), soybean (Wm82.a2, Glyma.01G000600 = Ensembl GLYMA_01G000600) and Medicago truncatula (A17 v5, MtrunA17Chr...).

tools.name: legume_pangene
tools.description:
The same gene across chickpea or pea assemblies and annotation versions, from LIS pangene sets (synteny-aware
clustering). Chickpea (Cicer.pan3): kabuli CDC Frontier v3 (Ca1g000200), v1/v2 (Ca_00003), desi ICC 4958 (Ca_) and
wild C. reticulatum (Cr1g…) and C. echinospermum (Ce…). Pea (Pisum.pan1): Cameor v1a (Psat1g000360 = Ensembl
pisum_sativum), Cameor v2 (Psat.1g…), JI2822 (PSAT_LOCUS… = Ensembl JI2822) and ZW6 (Psat01G…). gene: any of these
IDs or a pangene ID. Use it to convert IDs between assemblies (e.g. a kabuli Ca_ ID from a paper to the v3 gene
with expression data). dataset ('chickpea_desi', 'chickpea_kabuli_v1', ...) disambiguates a shared Ca_ ID.

tools.name: legume_genes_in_region
tools.description:
Chickpea, lentil or extra faba bean genes in a region (max 5 Mb) with descriptions, gene families, curated lentil
gene lists and best matches. dataset 'chickpea' (CDC Frontier v3, chromosomes chr1-chr8), 'chickpea_kabuli_v1'
(UWA kabuli v2.6.3, Ca1-Ca8), 'chickpea_desi' (UWA desi v3.0, Ca1-Ca8), 'lentil' (CDC Redberry v2, Chr1-Chr7),
'lentil_greenstar' (Lcu.1GRN.Chr1-7), 'lentil_ervoides' (Ler.1DRT.Chr1-7), 'faba_v2' (Hedin/2 v2, chr1_partA,
chr1_partB, chr2-chr6) or 'faba_tiffany' (chr1S, chr1L, chr2-chr6). Chromosome numbers alone (e.g. '4') are
accepted for chickpea and lentil.

tools.name: legume_family
tools.description:
Members of an LIS legume gene family across chickpea, lentil, pea, soybean and Medicago truncatula. gene: a
chickpea/lentil/pea/Medicago gene ID, a soybean Ensembl ID (GLYMA_01G000600) or LIS name (Glyma.01G000600), or a
family ID (Legume.fam3.00142). Use it to go from a soybean or pea gene (e.g. from orthologues or expression
results) to its chickpea and lentil relatives, or back. Families are broader than orthologue groups. dataset
(e.g. 'chickpea_desi' or 'chickpea_kabuli_v1') picks one when a Ca_ ID exists in several annotations.

tools.name: legume_pangene_presence
tools.description:
Presence/absence of a legume gene across the accessions of an LIS pangenome: soybean and wild soybean (32
annotations incl. Wm82, Lee, Zh13, Williams, Japanese and Chinese cultivars, G. soja W05/PI483463), Phaseolus (8,
common bean and wild relatives), Vigna (13: cowpea, adzuki bean, mungbean), Medicago (8), peanut (4), Cicer (4:
kabuli, desi, wild) and pea (3). gene: an LIS or Ensembl gene ID (GLYMA_01G000100 / Glyma.01G000100, Phvul..,
Vigun.., Medtr.., Ca1g.., Psat..) or a pangene ID. Returns which accessions carry a member (and how many copies),
which lack one, and the member IDs. Absence can be an annotation gap or divergence rather than a deletion.
Cite the LIS pangene set (pandagma, https://data.legumeinfo.org).

tools.name: legume_qtl
tools.description:
QTL and GWAS results for legumes: soybean (SoyBase QTL on genetic maps plus GWAS; marker positions on Wm82.a2 = Ensembl glycine_max), common bean (G19833 v1 = Ensembl phaseolus_vulgaris; some GWAS on G19833 v2), cowpea (IT97K-499-35 v1) and peanut (Tifrunner v2) from LIS; faba bean QTL markers from 56 studies (Faba Bean Genome Consortium compilation, positions on Hedin/2 v2 and projected to the Ensembl Hedin/2 v1 assembly); lentil protein and amino acid GWAS on the diversity panel (KnowPulse, CDC Redberry v2 = LIS lentil genes); chickpea, lentil, pea, faba bean, lupin, grass pea and pigeonpea QTL and GWAS from pulsedb.org (Cool Season Food Legume Database). Search by trait words (e.g.
'seed oil', 'pod dehiscence', 'chocolate spot', 'lysine'; soybean traits use SoyBase names such as 'SCN', 'SDS',
'Sclero', so check legume_qtl_traits) and/or a physical region (species + chromosome as in the
marker assembly or the Ensembl name, start, end). Returns each QTL (genetic map, linkage group, cM interval,
markers) or marker-trait association (marker, p-value where reported) with study, DOI and marker positions;
ensembl_region gives genes_in_region arguments where the markers are on the Ensembl assembly (faba bean: positions
projected from Hedin/2 v2 to v1 through gene matches, approximate), lis_region gives legume_genes_in_region
arguments (lentil).

tools.name: legume_qtl_traits
tools.description:
Traits with QTL or GWAS results, with counts per species (soybean (SoyBase QTL on genetic maps plus GWAS; marker positions on Wm82.a2 = Ensembl glycine_max), common bean (G19833 v1 = Ensembl phaseolus_vulgaris; some GWAS on G19833 v2), cowpea (IT97K-499-35 v1) and peanut (Tifrunner v2) from LIS; faba bean QTL markers from 56 studies (Faba Bean Genome Consortium compilation, positions on Hedin/2 v2 and projected to the Ensembl Hedin/2 v1 assembly); lentil protein and amino acid GWAS on the diversity panel (KnowPulse, CDC Redberry v2 = LIS lentil genes); chickpea, lentil, pea, faba bean, lupin, grass pea and pigeonpea QTL and GWAS from pulsedb.org (Cool Season Food Legume Database)).
query filters trait names (e.g. 'seed', 'rust').

tools.name: lupin_markers
tools.description:
Narrow-leafed lupin (Lupinus angustifolius) genetic map: 9,972 markers (DArTseq SNP/PAV, Fluidigm SNP, indel,
SSR, gene-based) and domestication loci (Tardus and Lentus pod shattering, Leucospermus white flower/seed,
Iucundus low alkaloid, Mollis soft seed, Ku vernalisation independence, Lanr1 anthracnose resistance) on the
97L380 RIL map (83A:476 x P27255), with positions on the Tanjil reference (= Ensembl Plants lupinus_angustifolius,
LG01-LG20) and Medicago Mt4.0 hits. Search by marker name (exact or prefix), trait words (e.g. 'alkaloid',
'pod shattering'), Tanjil region (chromosome LGxx + start/end) or map interval (chromosome + cm_start/cm_end).
For trait loci and unplaced markers the physical interval comes from the nearest anchored map neighbours, with
genes_in_region arguments.

tools.name: panel_haplotypes
tools.description:
SNP haplotypes of a gene across a diversity panel: accessions grouped by their SNP alleles in the gene
+-2 kb (MAF >= 0.02, <= 20% missing), each haplotype with size, number of alternative alleles, whether it is
reference-like and its accessions, plus the SNPs (position, alleles, frequency). Panels: 'lentil_ldp' = lentil diversity panel, 324 accessions, exome capture, CDC Redberry v2 (= LIS lentil gene IDs; KnowPulse); 'lentil_activate' = lentil diversity panel + ACTIVATE lines, 521 accessions, CDC Greenstar (Lcu.1GRN IDs; KnowPulse); 'cicer_wild_279' = 279 wild (C. reticulatum, C. echinospermum; population-site names such as Bari1_002) and cultivated chickpea accessions, resequencing, CDC Frontier v1 (kabuli v1 Ca_ IDs; von Wettberg et al. 2018); 'faba_norfab' = NORFAB faba bean panel, 196 accessions shown as 'name, origin country (Core code)' from Skovbjerg et al. 2023 Supplementary File 1 where listed, SPET, Ensembl Hedin/2 v1 (Aarhus University); 'pea_gwas_135' = field pea GWAS panel, 135 accessions including Australian PBA varieties (e.g. PBA_TWILIGHT, PBA_GUNYAH, STURT), GBS, sparse (about 3,000 genes with haplotypes), Ensembl Cameor v1a Psat IDs (ENA PRJEB35147).
gene: a chickpea kabuli v1 Ca_ ID (Ca_00001, wild Cicer panel), a lentil CDC Redberry v2 ID (Lcu.2RBY.1g000010), a CDC Greenstar ID (Lcu.1GRN.1g000010, for the LDP + ACTIVATE panel), a curated lentil symbol (e.g. LcFIE), or an Ensembl faba bean v1 ID (Vfaba.Hedin2.R1.1g000010, NORFAB). Matching genes in the other lentil assembly are tried too.

tools.name: snp_lines
tools.description:
Find SNP-genotyped lines in CropSNPdb by name or accession (e.g. 'Cascadia' (pea), 'CDC Asterix' (lentil)).
Returns line name, accession(s), country, pedigree, status, breeding organisation and donor. dataset: 'Pisum sativum Cameor v2 PSPPC' (default, alias 'pea'; 456 pea lines, GBS, 270K SNPs), 'Pisum sativum Cameor v2 AMS' ('pea_ams'; 240 lines, 641K SNPs), 'Lens culinaris CDC Redberry v2' ('lentil'; 324-line lentil diversity panel, exome capture, 460K SNPs), 'Cicer arietinum CDC Frontier v1' ('chickpea'; 279 wild and cultivated Cicer, WGS, 2.0M SNPs). Pea positions are Cameor v2 (not Ensembl Cameor v1a), chickpea CDC Frontier v1 (not v3).

tools.name: snp_genotypes
tools.description:
SNP genotype calls for up to 50 lines in a region (chromosome like 'chr1' (pea, lentil) or 'Ca1' (chickpea)). Returns markers with positions
and each line's call. Keep regions small (a few Mb) for many lines.

tools.name: snp_compare_lines
tools.description:
Compare two lines' SNP genotypes on a chromosome (optionally a region): markers compared, identical,
different, % identity and the regions where they differ (useful for pedigree/introgression questions).

tools.name: snp_haplotype_carriers
tools.description:
Lines that share a reference line's SNP haplotype in a region (max 5 Mb), e.g. which genebank lines carry the
Cascadia haplotype around a gene. Only markers polymorphic in the panel (minor allele frequency >= min_maf) are
used, and a match needs calls at >= min_called of them with at most max_mismatch differences. Always report
informative_markers and fraction_matching; if 'note' says the haplotype is common, say it is not diagnostic.

tools.name: snp_markers
tools.description: SNP markers (IDs and positions) of a CropSNPdb dataset in a region, with the total count.

tools.name: snp_phenotypes
tools.description:
Field trial trait data held in CropSNPdb for this crop (lentil diversity panel field traits (days to flowering, maturity and others; USASK)). With no arguments, lists the
available traits. Filter by line and/or trait: trait matches the
exact name or any part of it (e.g. 'Height', 'grain yield'). Most phenotyped lines are in the
Lens culinaris CDC Redberry v2 dataset.

tools.name: snp_gene
tools.description:
CropSNPdb SNPs in and around a gene (flank bp each side), placed on the dataset's own assembly: pea genes
(Ensembl Cameor v1a Psat IDs, through LIS pangenes, or Cameor v2 Psat. IDs) on the pea panels' Cameor v2,
lentil genes (Lcu.2RBY) on CDC Redberry v2, chickpea genes (kabuli v1 Ca_ or v3 Ca1g IDs) on CDC Frontier v1.
dataset: 'pea' (default for pea genes), 'pea_ams', 'lentil' or 'chickpea'; lines: up to 50 line names to
return their genotype calls as well. Say how the gene was placed (the 'via' field).

tools.name: legume_compare
tools.description:
A legume gene's counterparts in the other legume genomes in one call: chickpea CDC Frontier v3, wild Cicer
reticulatum and C. echinospermum, lentil CDC Redberry v2 and CDC Greenstar, pea Cameor v1a, faba bean Hedin/2 v1
and v2, narrow-leafed lupin Tanjil, common bean, soybean, cowpea, mungbean, pigeonpea, peanut and Medicago. For each species the counterpart gene(s) with the evidence behind each: synteny (the gene pair
sits in a collinear block; block size in anchor genes), Ensembl Compara orthology (Ensembl species pairs only),
shared LIS legume gene family, best protein hit; plus location, genome browser link, highest baseline expression
(TPM, tissue/condition) and QTL / GWAS markers within qtl_window_kb. gene: chickpea Ca1g000100, lentil
Lcu.2RBY.1g000010 or Greenstar Lcu.1GRN.1g000010, faba v2 Vfaba.Hedin2.R2.1g000001, C. reticulatum Cr1g000100,
an Ensembl gene ID or name (Psat1g000040, GLYMA_15G049200). For chickpea Ca_ IDs convert first with
legume_pangene. species: limit to these (ids or names).

tools.name: syntenic_region
tools.description:
Project a genomic interval (e.g. a QTL or GWAS region) from one pulse genome onto the syntenic regions of the
others, using collinear gene blocks. species / target: chickpea, cicer_reticulatum, cicer_echinospermum, lentil,
lentil_greenstar, pea, faba_bean (v1), faba_v2, lupin, common_bean, soybean, cowpea, mungbean, pigeonpea, peanut,
medicago (target omitted = all). chromosome as in that genome (chickpea 'chr5' or '5', lentil 'Chr3',
pea 'chr6LG2', soybean '15'...). Returns per target the syntenic interval(s): chromosome, span of the anchor genes,
number of anchor genes inside the query interval, orientation and block size, the anchor gene pairs and a genome
browser link. Several hits per target are expected after whole-genome duplications (soybean) or for paralogous
blocks; the one with most anchors is usually the orthologous region. Up to 20 Mb.

tools.name: qtl_colocation
tools.description:
Do QTL / GWAS loci for a trait sit in syntenic regions across pulse species? Takes the positioned
marker-trait associations for the trait (faba bean QTL compilation of 56 studies, lentil seed protein / amino acid
GWAS, soybean, common bean, cowpea and peanut GWAS / QTL markers from LIS), merges markers within window_kb into
loci, projects each locus onto the other genomes through collinear gene blocks, and lists the associations found
inside each projected region, flagging those for the same trait (all trait words present). Chickpea QTL markers named by their CDC Frontier v1 position (pulsedb.org) take part through the kabuli v1
gene set; pea, lupin and Medicago are projection targets only (their QTL have genetic-map positions, not physical ones). trait: words, e.g.
'flowering', 'seed weight', 'protein', 'Ascochyta'; species: limit the source species; targets: limit targets.

tools.name: expression_experiments
tools.description:
Soybean, Medicago, chickpea, pea and faba bean RNA-seq experiments held by askPulse (Expression Atlas, the Legume Information System for chickpea and pea, and faba bean studies quantified by askPulse): baseline (TPM by
tissue / developmental stage / treatment) and differential (stress, pathogen, genotype contrasts). query filters descriptions/labels (e.g. 'drought',
'grain', 'Fusarium'). Gives each experiment's assay groups (baseline) or contrasts (differential).

tools.name: gene_expression
tools.description:
Where and when a pulse and legume gene is expressed, and under which treatments it changes, from Expression Atlas, the Legume Information System for chickpea and pea, and faba bean studies quantified by askPulse.
gene: Ensembl gene ID (e.g. GLYMA_01G000600, pea Psat1g000360), a chickpea CDC Frontier v3 ID (Ca1g000100) or a gene name find_gene resolves. Baseline: TPM (median over replicates,
with range) for the top_groups highest-expressed tissues/stages per experiment. Differential: every contrast where
the gene is significant (adjusted p < 0.05, |log2FC| >= 1). experiment restricts to one accession; otherwise the
max_experiments baseline experiments with the highest TPM are detailed and the rest listed with their maximum.

tools.name: expression_genes
tools.description:
Genes characteristic of a tissue/stage or responsive to a treatment in one Expression Atlas experiment.
Baseline experiment + group (text matched to group labels, e.g. 'root', 'grain'): genes with TPM >= min_tpm in a
matching group ranked by specificity = (max TPM in matching groups + 1) / (max TPM in other groups + 1).
Differential experiment + contrast (text matched to contrast names or IDs): significant genes, direction 'up' or
'down', ranked by |log2FC|. Use expression_experiments() for group and contrast names.

tools.name: gwas_associations
tools.description:
Published GWAS marker-trait associations curated by GWAS Atlas (CNCB-NGDC), each with its position, trait
(Plant Trait Ontology), p-value, R2, population and paper (PMID). Data here: soybean (10,238 associations with p <= 0.01 from 76 papers, Wm82.a2 = Ensembl glycine_max, with the nearest gene). trait: words
('plant height', 'stripe rust', 'grain yield'); region: 'chromosome:start-end' on the stated assembly (e.g.
'6A:8-9Mb'); gene: a gene ID or symbol, giving associations within window_kb of it; species: limit to one species
(Ensembl name; default all, 'all' for every species); max_p: keep p-values at or below this. Results are sorted by p-value; by_trait and by_paper
summarise all matches.

tools.name: search_literature
tools.description:
Search publications and preprints in Europe PMC (PubMed, PMC, bioRxiv and others).

query: free text or Europe PMC syntax (e.g. 'grain size QTL 6A', 'TITLE:"pan-genome"').
gene: optional gene name or Ensembl ID; its curated synonyms and RefSeq IDs are OR-ed into the query
(e.g. gene='GLYMA_01G000600').
Words are matched in title and abstract; full_text=True also searches open-access full text.
crop_only requires a legume crop or genus name in title or abstract. sort: 'relevance', 'date' (newest first) or 'cited'.
Returns hit count and papers with DOI/PMID, year, journal, open-access flag, citations and a short abstract.

tools.name: get_paper
tools.description:
Full record for one paper: DOI (10.xxxx/..), PMID (digits) or PMCID (PMC...). Returns the abstract,
open-access status and full-text links.

tools.name: literature_gene_traits
tools.description:
Genes and Plant Trait Ontology terms mentioned together in open-access full-text papers (found with Europe PMC,
text from PubMed Central), mined by askCrop: in the same sentence (level 'sentence', stronger) or the same paragraph
of at most three genes (level 'paragraph'); tables and references are skipped. gene: a gene ID (or wheat symbol) gives the papers that name it and the traits it co-occurs with,
with example sentences; trait: words ('grain size', 'drought', 'flowering time') gives the genes most often named
alongside it. A co-mention is text evidence to read, not a demonstrated gene function: check the sentence and
paper. Each paper carries its licence: quote verbatim with citation, and summarise rather than reword quotes from
ND-licensed papers. Only papers whose full text is open access are covered.

tools.name: paper_qtl
tools.description:
QTL and marker-trait associations read from the tables of open-access pulse and legume papers (PubMed Central full
text, mostly 2015 onwards). Adds QTL tables for crops without a QTL database here (pea, lentil, chickpea, lupin, faba bean) and more for soybean and common bean. Search by trait words (matched in the table's trait column and caption),
chromosome ('Ca4', 'LG3', 'Gm05', 'chr2' (prefix as the paper writes it)), region ('Ca4:10-12Mb' on the assembly the paper used); species words ('chickpea', 'Cicer', 'lentil', 'soybean') from the paper title or table caption. Each row gives the
trait, QTL name, marker, chromosome, the position as reported (assembly as stated in the paper), cM, LOD, p, PVE,
the table caption and the paper with its licence. Chromosome names keep the paper's prefix (Ca, Gm, Pv, Vu, LG, chr); positions are on whatever assembly or map the paper used. Tables were parsed automatically: check a
surprising row in the paper.

tools.name: search_papers
tools.description:
Find open-access full-text papers that answer a question, by meaning as well as keywords (e.g. 'what limits
grain filling under heat stress', 'genes controlling spike architecture'). Combines vector search
(BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 embeddings) and keyword search, ranked by reciprocal rank fusion, and groups the hits by
paper: limit counts papers (default 10, max 50), each with its best passages (passages_per_paper 1-3) and section.
papers_matching_keywords tells you how many papers share the question's words: if it is much larger than what
you have, page with offset or narrow with year_from/year_to or a more specific question. Read a whole paper with
get_paper. Quote passages verbatim and cite the paper; summarise rather than reword quotes from no-derivatives
(ND) papers. Covers only open-access papers in PubMed Central; methods sections are not indexed.

tools.name: protein_structure
tools.description:
Predicted 3D structure of a gene's protein: its UniProtKB accession(s) (Ensembl Plants protein matches) and the
AlphaFold Protein Structure Database model for each, with mean pLDDT confidence and the fraction of residues in
each confidence band, plus viewer and file links. gene: symbol or Ensembl/IWGSC ID. Useful for judging whether a
coding variant or edit falls in a confidently folded domain. Cite AlphaFold DB (Varadi et al. 2024, Nucleic
Acids Res, doi:10.1093/nar/gkad1011) and UniProt.

tools.name: gene_pathways
tools.description:
Plant Reactome metabolic and signalling pathways of a gene (Gramene), with the top-level category and a link
to the pathway diagram. gene: an Ensembl Plants gene ID or a gene name/symbol. Pathways are projected from rice
by orthology, so say they are inferred. Use pathway_genes for the reverse (all genes of a pathway).

tools.name: pathway_genes
tools.description:
Genes in a Plant Reactome pathway: pathway is a name or words from it ('jasmonic acid biosynthesis',
'gibberellin', 'flavonoid') or a stable ID (R-TAE-1119332). species: a species name as Plant Reactome writes it
('Triticum aestivum', 'Brassica napus', 'Glycine max'); default all species loaded for this site. Matching pathways
are listed with their genes per species. Membership is projected from rice by orthology.

tools.name: trait_hits
tools.description:
Trait-associated positions across the genome for a chromosome overview: GWAS marker-trait associations and
peaks, named trait genes and mapped trait loci held by this site, with chromosome sizes, each with a genome browser
link where the assembly is loaded. trait: words to match (e.g. 'height', 'oil', 'alkaloid'); chromosome filters
one chromosome. Map marker tracks are left out unless a chromosome is given. Tracks with karyotype false are on
another assembly than chromosome_sizes (pulse: soybean and common bean, Ensembl chromosome numbers; faba bean on
Hedin/2 v2 and projected v1; lentil CDC Redberry v2).

tools.name: genes_with_annotation
tools.description:
Find genes by function: GO term, InterPro or Pfam domain (accession or words, e.g. 'NB-ARC', 'IPR002182',
'GO:0009414', 'disease resistance', 'MADS-box') or Plant Reactome pathway ('gibberellin biosynthesis',
R-TAE-...; kind='pathway'). kind: GO, InterPro, Pfam or pathway (default: GO + InterPro + Pfam). Optional species
(Ensembl name) and region (chromosome, start, end in bp on the Ensembl/RefSeq v1.0 assembly) filters, e.g. all
NLR genes in a QTL interval. Returns matching genes with location, matched terms and genome browser link, plus
facet counts by species, chromosome and term. Annotations are electronic (InterProScan, GO from InterPro2GO).

tools.name: gene_neighbourhood
tools.description:
Gene neighbourhood (microsynteny): the gene and its flanking genes, with their orthologues in related genomes
(pea, faba bean, Medicago, soybean, common bean, lupin) from Ensembl Compara. For each target genome, the collinear block holding most
orthologues of the neighbourhood is reported with how many neighbours are conserved there, so a candidate gene can
be checked for a conserved genomic context. flank: genes each side (default 8, max 25). targets: Ensembl genome
names (default ['pisum_sativum', 'vicia_faba', 'medicago_truncatula', 'glycine_max', 'phaseolus_vulgaris', 'lupinus_angustifolius']).

tools.name: gene_papers
tools.description:
Papers mentioning a gene: Europe PMC search for its gene IDs (all versions, in open-access full text) and its
name/symbols (in title or abstract, with a legume crop or genus name). Each paper says whether it matched an ID or a
name. Name matches can be another gene with the same symbol: check the abstract.

tools.name: annotate_genes
tools.description:
Annotate a list of genes (up to 500 IDs or names) in one call: resolved ID, species, location, name, top
InterPro/Pfam domains, GO terms, Plant Reactome pathways and orthologues in the main related genomes
(['pisum_sativum', 'vicia_faba', 'medicago_truncatula', 'glycine_max', 'phaseolus_vulgaris', 'lupinus_angustifolius']). For gene-list follow-up after an experiment (DE genes, GWAS candidates); the web
page genes.html (gene-list tab) runs this and downloads a TSV.

tools.name: blast_sequence
tools.description:
BLAST a DNA or protein sequence (raw or FASTA; up to 20 kb DNA or 5,000 aa) against this site's databases:
pea, narrow-leafed lupin, faba bean, soybean, common bean, chickpea and lentil genomes, CDS and proteins. The program is chosen from the query and database types (blastn, or blastn-short under 50 nt;
blastx; blastp; tblastn against CDS only). databases: ids from the list this tool returns (default: DNA query ->
reference genome + all CDS sets; protein -> all protein sets). Hits give gene ID (CDS/protein) or genome position
with overlapping genes, identity, alignment length, e-value and a genome browser link. People can use the
SequenceServer page at /blast/ for the same databases.

tools.name: pulse_gene_view
tools.description: Interactive gene view for one pulse and legume gene: a relationship map of its orthologues across legumes (Ensembl Compara), members of its LIS legume gene family (chickpea, lentil, pea, soybean, Medicago), Arabidopsis function, expression contrasts and recent papers, with tabs for the gene family by species and baseline expression (LIS chickpea and pea atlases, Expression Atlas). Clients that support MCP Apps show it in the chat; the result also lists the nodes, the panel data and the gene page link (page) to share. gene: gene name or Ensembl/LIS ID.

tools.name: genesys_accession
tools.description:
Genebank accessions from Genesys (Crop Trust), live: full passport data (holder, accession number and names,
taxon, biological status, country and site of origin, coordinates, pedigree), whether the accession is available,
in the Multilateral System (SMTA) and safety-duplicated in Svalbard, whether the holder takes requests through
Genesys, a DOI where assigned, and the climate at the collection site (WorldClim: mean temperature, temperature
extremes, precipitation). accession: accession number (e.g. 'PI 591780', 'IG 32990'); holder: FAO WIEWS code
(e.g. USA029, LBN002, AUS165) to make it unique; name: free text (e.g. 'Chinese Spring') when the number is not
known; crop: Genesys crop code (wheat, barley, chickpea, lentil, pea ...) to narrow a name search.
